attributes.raw-text:
Planetary Governor @"High Duke Gene Marte" of #"Mani's Stand" calls the characters  with a problem but it is top secret and he will not tell them anything until their discretion is assured.  

1. Message from the Governor direct, but how to answer?
2. Governors Secretary @"Earl Jerey Parkell" considers the characters to low brow, how to get to the governor
3. No help, Police Chief @"Sir Juany Ramas" is in on it and arrest them for lesse majesty towards the governor, forgery, etc.
4. The big plan, Play by ear.
5. Mission, goto the robofac, @"Duke Tery Warder" has produced very little in 2 months, find out why and fix it.  The Duke has been an enemy of the High Duke for the last two years, but they were allies in the past.

*"5RD1-1-5"
